target_definition: Daily positive item transaction sales, units, seven daily horizons; observed-sales demand proxy, not latent demand

provenance.citation: Chen, D. (2012). Online Retail II [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D.

split.selection_basis: training only; zero-sales or historically inactive test series remain eligible; no test-based item selection
split.population: known SKU, all countries aggregated within original single UK retailer

sample_sizes.overlap_note: 22 daily origins x 7 horizon predictions; repeated target observations are separate forecast tasks, not independent outcomes

ridge_lag_calendar.fit_policy: Fixed training cutoff 2011-10-13; later origin-and-earlier history is legitimate lag input, never future labels.

AC11.reason: Official licensed bytes profiled; target, train-only eligible SKU catalog, full calendar split and incomplete trailing day frozen; interior zero dates rely on publisher complete-ledger declaration.

AC12.reason: Frozen chronological known-item study with both baselines, compact lag/calendar candidate, validation-only tuning, untouched test metrics, dependence-aware comparisons, slices and sensitivity. No observed-business-utility or real alert-validity claim.
AC12.quality_warning: Gate reflects reproducible limited-scope evaluation, not adequate accuracy. Selected moving-average WAPE exceeds 100%; zero-only posthoc diagnostic is 100%. No learned-model improvement established.

limitations: No empirical MR D.I.Y. accuracy claim; synthetic company mechanics are separate.
No inventory, lead-time, stockout, delivery or operating-cost ground truth.
Known-item temporal evaluation only; cold-start and cross-company performance not established.
Retrospective transaction-time availability assumption; historical system-known replay and late-update logs unavailable.
Complete-ledger observation scope is source-declared, not independently audited; missing SKU-day zeros mean zero recorded positive sales, never latent demand.
warnings: Point forecasts only: calibrated prediction intervals are not produced.
Forecast errors are high: the retained moving-average test WAPE is 103.41%; no adequate-accuracy or improved-model claim.

selection.reason: Validation winner retained with disclosed test evidence

seasonal_naive_7.uncertainty_method: two-way cluster bootstrap: resample known SKU groups and nonoverlapping seven-origin time blocks (last block partial); each selected block retains all 7 overlapping forecast horizons
seasonal_naive_7.limitations: Four short time blocks and related retailer SKUs limit inference; descriptive dependence-aware uncertainty, not cross-company evidence.

moving_average_28.uncertainty_method: two-way cluster bootstrap: resample known SKU groups and nonoverlapping seven-origin time blocks (last block partial); each selected block retains all 7 overlapping forecast horizons
moving_average_28.limitations: Four short time blocks and related retailer SKUs limit inference; descriptive dependence-aware uncertainty, not cross-company evidence.

model_card.feature_policy: only origin-and-earlier sales lags/rolling summaries; future target weekday is deterministic calendar, no external news or future realized values
model_card.candidate: pooled scale-normalized direct ridge, 7 separate linear horizons, nonnegative point output
model_card.normalization: per-SKU training-only mean bounded below 1; no test preprocessing
model_card.model_selection_policy: alpha and winner selected on validation WAPE only; candidate retained for recommended use only if paired test uncertainty against validation-best baseline supports improvement; otherwise retain validation-best baseline

alert_evaluation.reason: Sales-only ledger has no actual shortage event/window labels, stock state or feasible warning lead time; real false-positive/false-negative/precision/recall claims unavailable. Simulated labels must be separately identified.

posthoc_diagnostics.selection_role: none; added after viewing primary test results solely for sparse-series interpretation

test.WAPE_zero_denominator_handling: null; no averaging item-level percentage errors

zero_forecast.interpretation: WAPE is exactly 1 for nonzero total sales; can score deceptively well on intermittent sales while providing no replenishment signal. Not an approved replacement or post-test model choice.

ledger_free_day_interpretation.assumption: Publisher complete-ledger declaration allows zero recorded sales on interior free dates; does not prove zero latent demand.

test_outlier_slices.selection_rule: posthoc volume-based error interpretation; no items removed from primary result

exclude_ledger_free_target_dates.limitation: Observed transaction-active target days only; this changes scoring population and cannot replace seven-day forecast evaluation.

knowledge_as_of_reason: Rolling per-origin cutoffs; see split and model feature availability policy. No one historical system-known acquisition timestamp exists.
world_time_reason: Multi-origin validation/test evaluation over frozen calendar periods.
timezone_reason: UCI transaction timestamps lack timezone; original calendar labels are preserved.
